description: SSE load (PVA-M2.12): 12 streams for 900 s, fixture provider, GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner. The nightly gates on the absolute testing.md thresholds (TTFE p95 < 1.5 s, gap p95 < 0.5 s) plus the harness checks. A relative ratchet (baseline x 1.2) is enabled by adding ttfe_p95_seconds and gap_p95_seconds here once at least 10 nightly samples give a stable p50: two runs on 2026-11-14 differed by 2.2x (runner variance).
